lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical column of three high-intensity circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, followed by a series of roughly equidistant columns of smaller blobs forming a rectangular grid across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular clusters, creating a visible lattice-like arrangement across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive 'U-shaped' or looped arrangement of spots is present in the first vertical column immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
